capabilities: Fill PDF form fields and add text boxes
Draw with pen and highlighter tools
Edit PDFs inside notes, tabs, and pop-out windows
Copy printed text and zoom with viewer controls
extras: Desktop-only beta (requires Obsidian 1.13.7+; Windows unverified). Manual install from release files is described. Editing limitations: existing printed text cannot be rewritten; encrypted PDFs, XFA forms, and signature fields unsupported. Author warns to keep backups and edit each PDF in only one app/device at a time. MIT licensed with third-party credits.
problem: Obsidian can only view PDFs, so annotating or filling PDF forms requires leaving the app for external PDF software.
summary: PDF editor that lets you fill form fields, add text boxes, highlight, and draw on PDFs directly in Obsidian tabs, notes, and pop-out windows.
